# TV Guide

> > The definitive source for TV listings, streaming recommendations, live sports schedules, and entertainment news across all major platforms including Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, Peacock, and HBO Max.

TV Guide provides comprehensive television schedules for broadcast, cable, satellite, and streaming services, along with entertainment news, celebrity coverage, and expert recommendations. The site covers local TV listings for cities across the United States and features dedicated guides for major streaming platforms and live sports programming.

## Key Topics

- TV listings and schedules
- Streaming services (Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, Peacock, HBO Max, Paramount+, Tubi)
- Live sports coverage (MLB, NBA, NHL, NCAA)
- Entertainment and celebrity news
- Local broadcast schedules
- Show and movie recommendations
- Antenna, cable, and satellite TV
- Streaming recommendations
- Sports broadcast schedules
- TV reviews and guides
- Popular shows (Yellowstone, One Piece, Scarpetta)
- Entertainment journalists (Tim Surette, Megan Vick, Kat Moon, Lauren Piester)
- World Baseball Classic and Tokyo Dome coverage

## Core TV Listings

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage featuring streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): Main TV schedule and listings page for shows, movies, and programs

## Streaming Service Guides

- [What to Watch on Netflix - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/streaming/netflix): Netflix streaming guide with 6,443 movies and TV shows to watch

## Live Sports Schedules

- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Live sports schedule with MLB, NBA, NHL, NCAA, and international games
